archive.catalogue_description: Guys i’ve been working hard to fix and improve the map. This is the Final version, i finally fixed the hintstrings and several other problems. I hope everything is fine now. Far Away 3 is even more improved than Far Away 2 and has new unique features. This can be quite a hard map so either make sure you have the skills or grab some friends. Features: -Black Ops Quick Revive,5-hit Jugg,Double Tap 2.0. -New features,new camos. -More pizza -A few black ops guns -1 BO2 gun -Lots more you will find in the map! Credits: Ugx Rorke JBird632 BluntStuffy HitmanVere __________________________________________ Download: http://bit.ly/1Rj9GgN __________________________________________ Leave a comment if you are wondering about anything. I hope you enjoy! __________________________________________ Final Version details: -Fixed hintstring problem where you would go up to a perk, PaP, or the ending and get a weird hintstring. -Fixed End area glitch. -Some other things added in the actual map that should make some things clearer. -Fixed kar98k hintstring. -Fixed a specific door hintstring. -Scavenger damage update, -silenced Gewehr damage update, -aperture M1carbine damage update, -Kiparis damage update -Some PaPed guns damage update. -A few new Camos! -M1 Garand has a new PaP version of itself.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
